scheme_name: Fellowship Scheme for M.Phil & Ph.D for Scheduled Caste Students (Maharaja Sayajirao Gayakvad Scholarship)
other_conditions: Student must be enrolled in an M.Phil or Ph.D program
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹2,500 for M.Phil students and ₹10,000 for Ph.D students, payable for 10 months.
